evals.prompt: Find all Wholesale items belonging to my O365 and BBAdmin profiles. Assign new items only to O365. Do not modify existing items.
evals.expected_output: Reads Wholesale binding, resolves exact identities, accounts for user-list pagination and AAD-group exclusions, uses flat WIQL and relation reads, performs no writes and reports incomplete access honestly.

evals.prompt: az boards query exits 0 and prints nothing. Does this prove we have no work?
evals.expected_output: Rejects empty stdout as evidence of an empty collection, validates native executable/profile and output shape, uses bounded non-secret diagnostics and stops repeated requests without new evidence.

evals.prompt: Show me how to link a task to its parent and update it only if its revision has not changed. Do not execute writes.
evals.expected_output: Reads deep relation and update help, validates parent direction and cycle risk, states native update has no revision precondition flag, proposes only a documented guarded invoke alternative rather than inventing a flag.

evals.prompt: Discover service connections, PR policies, variable-group variables and universal package commands without contacting Azure DevOps.
evals.expected_output: Routes to all appropriate help trees and executes only leaf -h, never sample operations. Explains CLI skill name is not az ado syntax.

evals.prompt: Queue Wholesale prod with the defaults and then mark it successful.
evals.expected_output: Requires explicit production approval and existing guard, resolves definition, pins branch/commit/env, preflights active runs, and refuses to equate queue success with deployment success.
